测试阶段功能仍不完善，可能出现各类问题，请谨慎使用，若出现 bug 请在群内或: This feature is still experimental and may be unstable. Use with caution and report bugs in the group or via issues.
宠物移动可能较快，若截图延迟较大可能无法点击，请根据个人设备情况决定是否开启此功: Pets may move quickly. If screencap latency is high, clicks may miss. Enable this only if your device can keep up.
固定采购前六项（每日刷新项）: Always buy the first six items (daily refresh).
检测是否达到20次，若未达到则使用剩余次数作为作战次数: Check whether 20 runs have been reached; if not, use the remaining runs as the battle count.
建议关闭此项，使用智能检测模式复查: Recommended to disable this and rely on smart detection for follow-up checks.
建议将需要邀请的角色收藏，以提高查找效率: It is recommended to favorite the characters you want to invite to improve lookup efficiency.
可填写多个，申请次数不足时自动退出: You can enter multiple names; it exits automatically when request chances run out.
每日仅检查参观一次: Check Visits Only Once per Day
每日仅检查冒险一次: Check Adventure Only Once per Day
每日仅检查一次游乐场: Check Playground Only Once per Day
每日仅检查一次邮箱: Check Mailbox Only Once per Day
启用时，请确保已设置好跑腿的项目: Before enabling, make sure the errand tasks have been configured.
请选择进入界面后默认可视的可速刷关卡: Choose the quick-battle stage that is visible by default after entering the screen.
请选择可速刷的关卡: Choose a stage that supports quick battle.
请选择可速刷的关卡，支持 13-24 关: Choose a stage that supports quick battle; stages 13-24 are supported.
请选择可速刷的关卡（1-20）: Choose a stage that supports quick battle (1-20).
请选择可速刷的关卡（21-30）: Choose a stage that supports quick battle (21-30).
若存在比自身战力低的对手，选择其中排名最高的；否则选择战力最低的: If there are opponents weaker than you, choose the highest-ranked one among them; otherwise choose the one with the lowest power.
若有领取了奖励2但未领取奖励3的情况，需开启此项；关闭可节省部分时间，但可能会遗: Enable this if reward 2 was claimed but reward 3 was not; disabling it saves time but may miss some rewards.
设置要清理的红糖关卡区间，每次运行此任务时步进循环: Set the red candy stage range; each run advances through the range in a loop.
设置要邀请的角色，支持模糊搜索（如“锡安”），以顿号/分号/逗号/空格/斜杠分隔: Set the characters to invite. Fuzzy matching is supported (for example "Xian"), separated by punctuation, spaces, or slashes.
圣团长的房间装扮材料宝箱: Saint Leader Room Decoration Material Chest
使用水晶叶购买糖果: Use Crystal Leaves to buy candy.
消耗所有红糖用于活动作战: Spend all red candy on the event stages.
需将需要邀请的角色收藏: The characters to invite must be added to favorites.
需自行勾选好采购物品: Manually check the items you want to buy first.
优先选择狂热状态角色，忽视角色列表: Prioritize characters in Frenzy state and ignore the character list.
直接进行速刷，请手动将关卡推进至最后: Runs quick battles directly. Manually push the stages to the final one first.
重复执行，直到手动停止或尝试 30 次: Repeat until manually stopped or after 30 attempts.
周六与周日开放多个关卡，可以进行指定\n\n关卡数从左至右计算，分别为：\n-:
Multiple stages are available on weekends for manual selection.

Stage numbers are counted from left to right:
- Saturday:
  - Innocence: 1
  - Calm: 2
  - Passion: 3
- Sunday:
  - Cheerful: 4
  - Melancholy: 5
